category5.design: The changed fold_12 is used by crc32_pclmulqdq and crc32_vpclmulqdq_avx2 but not by crc32_vpclmulqdq_avx512, which zlib-ng's run-time dispatch picks on AVX-512 hosts, so fuzzer_minigzip's "incorrect data check" depends on the judge's CPU. The driver (no dataset program fits) calls the build's crc32_pclmulqdq directly on the PoV, independent of the dispatch; output-diff.
